key_highlights: ASX 200 futures point to a lower open pressured by Wall Street weakness and cautious sentiment ahead of domestic jobs data.
Consumer and retail sector reels from the collapse of General Pants and 1,500 redundancies at David Jones.
Macro headwinds intensify with rising unemployment, sticky wage growth, a divided RBA board, and a falling AUD pressured by the Fed.
Materials and tech face downward pressure, while energy equities show counter-cyclical gains.

sectors.trend: Downward pressure on bulk miners and gold producers following broader metal price corrections and long-term Pilbara supply concerns.
sectors.implications: Heavy index drag on ^AXJO from majors (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX), despite selective capital activity in junior critical mineral explorers.

sectors.trend: Severe solvency stress and restructuring triggered by elevated living costs and spending contraction.
sectors.implications: Heightened credit risks and margin erosion across apparel and department store retailers (HVN.AX, PMV.AX).

sectors.trend: Emerging stagflation signals as unemployment climbs alongside persistent wage growth, complicating RBA policy trajectory.
sectors.implications: Margin compression risk and potential uptick in bad debt provisions for major banks (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX).

sectors.trend: Valuation pressure tracking global tech pullbacks and governance volatility, despite long-term data centre expansion.
sectors.implications: Near-term downside for high-multiple ASX tech names (WTC.AX, XRO.AX).

sectors.trend: Resilient baseline consumer demand tempered by cyber and operational vulnerabilities.
sectors.implications: Short-term headline and remediation risk for Coles (COL.AX), though grocery revenues remain defensively positioned.

sectors.trend: Short-term outperformance counter to broader market softness, constrained by medium-term global supply surplus risks.
sectors.implications: Near-term support for producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX), but upside capped by potential oil glut.

key_themes: Stagflationary dilemma: Rising unemployment coupled with accelerated wage growth restricts RBA policy flexibility.
Retail distress: Accelerated insolvencies and store downsizing highlight depleted household buffers.
Currency weakness: US dollar strength driving AUD depreciation, elevating imported cost pressures.
Commodity realignment: Iron ore faces structural volume challenges while gold endures sharp volatility.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight cyclical equities and tilt towards defensive, cash-generative assets.
Avoid exposed discretionary retail names and retail REIT landlords.
Increase exposure to unhedged offshore earnings and USD-earning healthcare and industrial exporters.
Reduce pure-play iron ore exposure (FMG.AX) in favor of low-cost, diversified miners.

opportunities.rationale: Directly benefits from AUD weakness against the USD while providing defensive earnings insulated from domestic retail headwinds.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to critical minerals and antimony developers with funded offtakes.
opportunities.rationale: Prepayment-funded development provides idiosyncratic growth insulated from broader mining index weakness.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight ASX Consumer Discretionary and retail REITs.
defensive_moves.rationale: General Pants collapse and David Jones cuts signal accelerating tenant stress and consumer spending retreat.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to major domestic retail banks.
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising unemployment and housing market pressure heighten risk of mortgage delinquency and margin compression.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish bias over 1–3 months. The ASX 200 faces headwinds from Wall Street weakness, rising domestic unemployment, and retail insolvencies.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautious neutral over 6–12 months. Medium-term trajectory hinges on RBA monetary easing capacity, AUD stabilization, and Chinese commodity demand.
key_catalysts: ABS domestic employment and wage data releases
RBA monetary policy decisions and statement on monetary policy
US Federal Reserve rate trajectory and dollar index movements
watch_list: Retail insolvencies and bank non-performing loan metrics
